name: quizcrowd-fabric
description: Live quizzes and manually authored surveys for Microsoft Fabric Apps.

template.name: quizcrowd-fabric
template.description: Entra-secured live quizzes and surveys with private Fabric SQL persistence.

scripts.build: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w rayfin-functions build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build
scripts.build:fabric: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/frontend build:fabric
scripts.pretest: npm run -w @rayfin-app/shared build && npm run -w @rayfin-app/data build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
